subject: mathematics
title: Round 68 to 70
objective: Round numbers to the nearest ten, hundred, or thousand.
introduction: Milo found 68 leaves and wants to round them to the nearest ten. Which nearby ten is closest?

vocabulary.definition: The ones digit is 8, so 68 rounds up to 70.
The tens digit is 2, so 527 stays at the lower hundred, 500.
The hundreds digit is 3, so 4,320 stays at the lower thousand, 4,000.

items.explanation: 68 is between 60 and 70. The ones digit 8 is 5 or more, so 68 rounds up to 70.
527 is between 500 and 600. The tens digit 2 is less than 5, so 527 rounds down to 500.
4,320 is between 4,000 and 5,000. The hundreds digit 3 is less than 5, so it rounds down to 4,000.
2,683 is between 2,600 and 2,700. The tens digit 8 is 5 or more, so it rounds up to 2,700.

items.prompt: Maxine has 84 stickers. About how many stickers does she have, to the nearest ten?
items.explanation: 84 is between 80 and 90. The ones digit 4 is less than 5, so 84 rounds down to 80.
